title: ServiceSource's FBI AbilityOne Contract and the Disability-Employment Requirement GAO Said the Program Struggled to Verify
subtitle: THE DEAL: 75% DIRECT LABOR HOURS FROM DISABLED WORKERS. THE OVERSIGHT: QUESTIONED BY GAO IN 2013.
subject: ServiceSource Inc / FBI / AbilityOne
hook: Federal law gives qualified AbilityOne nonprofits mandatory-source access to covered contracts if at least 75 percent of direct labor hours are performed by workers who are blind or have significant disabilities. A 2013 GAO report found the oversight body lacked sufficient data to gauge compliance.

title: The Pentagon Has Failed Its Audit for 7 Straight Years
subtitle: SEVEN YEARS. ZERO CLEAN BOOKS.
subject: Department of Defense / Pete Hegseth
hook: The largest organization in the world cannot account for its own money. Seven audits. Seven failures. Zero consequences.

title: The VA Sole-Sourced Its Core EHR Modernization Contract to Cerner. GAO Reported $9.4 Billion Obligated. After Patient Safety Events, It Halted Deployments in 2023.
subtitle: SOLE SOURCE. $9.4 BILLION. HALTED.
subject: Oracle Health / VA / Doug Collins
hook: In May 2018, the VA bypassed competition and awarded Cerner a sole-source contract for its entire electronic health record system. GAO reported $9.4 billion obligated by March 2023. After the VA's own Inspector General documented patient safety events at deployed sites, VA halted all future deployments in April 2023.
